_docScramble: Phase 4 scramble balance (play/sim.ts). tackleBonus: tackle factor on a scrambling QB. flatSlow: a scrambling QB behind the line loses this share of his speed when running straight across the field (cos of the run angle). Rushers chase a scrambling QB with a pursuit angle; an edge rusher on the side the QB runs to aims containOutside yd outside him (contain). Spies and zone defenders leave their zone once the QB is outside boxWidth yd of the ball or runs upfield faster than upfieldSpeed yd/s: spies after spyRead s, underneath zones after underneathRead s, deep zones after deepRead s (plus reaction x reactFactor). Man defenders stay on their man until the QB crosses the line (then the normal run read). throwOnRunPressure: added to the pocket pressure (max 1) for a throw while scrambling: throws on the run under pressure miss more (more throw-aways, more incompletes).
